name: openapi-api-contract-starter
description: A practical OpenAPI-first foundation for designing, documenting, and validating HTTP API contracts.

scripts.swagger:assets: shx cp -r node_modules/swagger-ui-dist dist/swagger && shx cp swagger-ui/swagger-initializer.js dist/swagger/swagger-initializer.js
scripts.build:docs: npm run clean && npm run bundle && npm run swagger:assets && shx cp dist/openapi.bundle.yaml dist/swagger/openapi.yaml
